beats.label: S1 · The guns
beats.text: The Peaky Blinders seize a crate of army rifles meant for Libya; Tommy hides them as leverage, defying Polly's warning to return them quietly.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The guns are the engine of the whole season — every antagonist enters because of them.

beats.label: S1 · Campbell and Grace
beats.text: Churchill sends Chief Inspector Campbell to Birmingham to recover the guns; Campbell plants Grace as a barmaid inside the Garrison to spy on Tommy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces both antagonists at once and the spy-inside-the-family device.

beats.label: S1 · Grace turns
beats.text: Grace falls for Tommy while feeding Campbell information; Tommy, half-suspicious, hires her as his secretary anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The romantic betrayal setup that pays off in the finale and reshapes S2.

beats.label: S1 · Ada and Freddie
beats.text: Ada marries Freddie Thorne in secret and bears his child; when Freddie visits the newborn, he is arrested, and Ada blames Tommy for the betrayal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Ada's estrangement from the family that shapes her role for seasons to come.

beats.label: S1 · The Lees alliance
beats.text: Tommy schemes to muscle in on Billy Kimber's races, brokering an uneasy alliance with the Romani Lees by marrying John to their daughter Esme.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Peaky Blinders' first move from street gang to organised racing empire.

beats.label: S1 · Grace chooses Tommy
beats.text: Grace hands Campbell the guns' location, resigns from the Crown, and sleeps with Tommy; Campbell, secretly watching, proposes to her and is rejected.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Triangle collapses into open enmity and sets the station showdown.

beats.label: S1 · The yard
beats.text: Kimber ambushes the yard and kills one of Tommy's own; Tommy shoots Kimber dead. Grace boards a train for London as Campbell aims his pistol at her — a shot fires.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kimber removed, the racing throne opens, and the finale gunshot is the door into S2.

cliffhanger.text: A gunshot rings out on the Birmingham station platform as Campbell levels his pistol at Grace. Tommy sits at his farmhouse, coin in hand, weighing whether to follow her to London.
questions: Did Campbell kill Grace, or did she outdraw him?
Will Tommy leave Birmingham for a new life with her?
With Kimber dead, who steps into the empty throne above the tracks?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: Peaky Blinders leader and decorated war veteran, now the effective head of the family and torn between Grace and Small Heath.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Volatile eldest brother, half-broken by the trenches, who tried to hang himself this season and survived by chance.

characters.name: Polly Gray
characters.line: The Shelby aunt who ran the family through the war; the moral counterweight and Tommy's only real check.

characters.name: John Shelby
characters.line: Middle brother, freshly widowed and freshly remarried — bound to the Lees by his arranged marriage to Esme.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: Tommy's sister, now Freddie's wife and mother to a newborn, estranged from the family after Freddie's arrest.

characters.name: Freddie Thorne
characters.line: Communist organiser and Ada's husband, sprung from prison by Danny and hiding at season's end.

characters.name: Grace Burgess
characters.line: Campbell's Irish informant turned Tommy's lover, on a train for London when Campbell finds her.

characters.name: Chester Campbell
characters.line: Ulster Special Branch inspector who lost the guns and his prize; now confronting Grace at the platform.

beats.label: S2 · Two years on
beats.text: The Garrison is bombed at Freddie's funeral; Campbell resurfaces as a Secret Service Major with proof Tommy has been killing for the IRA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Time-jumps the show and reinstalls the same antagonist with new leverage.

beats.label: S2 · London and Alfie
beats.text: Tommy pushes the business into London, sparks a turf war with Darby Sabini, and takes Camden's Jewish gang boss Alfie Solomons as an unreliable ally.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Alfie, the show's most durable outside player.

beats.label: S2 · Polly's son
beats.text: Polly is reunited with the son taken from her years before; Michael comes to Small Heath and asks Tommy for a job.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Michael, who becomes a load-bearing player through the rest of the series.

beats.label: S2 · Arthur unravels
beats.text: Arthur, sunk into cocaine and war flashbacks, kills a boy in a boxing ring and is later lured into Alfie's Passover slaughter and imprisoned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Arthur's addiction spiral and Alfie's willingness to betray.

beats.label: S2 · Grace returns
beats.text: Grace comes back to Tommy married but pregnant with his child; Campbell, meanwhile, forces Polly into his bed as the price of Michael's release.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both pregnancies and Polly's rape underwrite everything Tommy and Polly do at Derby.

beats.label: S2 · Derby Day
beats.text: Ulster Volunteers kidnap Tommy on Churchill's order to be executed; Polly walks into Campbell's office and shoots him dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Campbell and puts Tommy in Churchill's pocket.

beats.label: S2 · Spared
beats.text: The killers turn on their own and Tommy is spared, told Winston Churchill will call again; Michael commits to the family and Tommy to marrying Grace.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every S3 plot begins with a Crown favour Tommy owes and a wedding he plans.

cliffhanger.text: Tommy is alive because a Crown assassin turned at the last second, and the message is that Churchill now owns him. Grace carries his child, and the family limps toward a wedding.
questions: What will Churchill demand in return for Tommy's life?
Can Tommy really walk away from the gang for Grace?
With Michael inside, is Polly still the family's true head?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: Now on the Crown's leash after Derby Day; engaged to Grace and running an empire that stretches from Small Heath to Camden.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Out of prison thanks to Alfie's back-channel, deeper into cocaine and PTSD than when the season began.

characters.name: Polly Gray
characters.line: Killed Campbell in cold blood to save Tommy, and has her son Michael back after twenty years.

characters.name: Michael Gray
characters.line: Polly's biological son, newly inducted into the family business and hungry for a bigger role.

characters.name: John Shelby
characters.line: Peaky Blinder middle brother, still married to Esme, running Birmingham operations while Tommy is in London.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: Widowed by Freddie between seasons, drifting back into the family orbit as an uneasy ally.

characters.name: Grace Burgess
characters.line: Pregnant with Tommy's child, leaving her New York husband, set to marry Tommy at last.

characters.name: Alfie Solomons
characters.line: Camden's Jewish gang boss — a useful partner who has already betrayed Tommy once, to Sabini.

beats.label: S3 · The wedding job
beats.text: Tommy marries Grace, but the wedding pulls him into a Section D scheme run by Father John Hughes to arm White Russian exiles against the Soviets.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and the impossible favour Tommy owes the Crown.

beats.label: S3 · Grace killed
beats.text: Tommy backs John's feud with the Changretta family; at a Shelby charity gala, Vicente Changretta's shooter fires and Grace dies in Tommy's arms.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wife-death and a blood feud with New York's Changretta name — both drive S4.

beats.label: S3 · Revenge and Boston
beats.text: Tommy locks his grief away and greenlights Vicente's murder; Ada is offered the family's new Boston office and takes it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills Vicente, seeding Luca's vendetta, and puts Ada on a plane.

beats.label: S3 · Charles taken
beats.text: Father Hughes reveals he has snatched Tommy's small son Charles, and will only return him if Tommy carries out the Russian arms deal in full.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Tommy from operator into hostage and sets the finale's stakes.

beats.label: S3 · The vault
beats.text: The Peaky Blinders tunnel into the Russians' vault and steal the jewels; Michael rescues Charles and shoots Father Hughes for the abuse Michael survived as a child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Michael becomes a killer — the moral hinge that defines his later arc.

beats.label: S3 · The train
beats.text: Word doesn't reach the brothers in time and the Russian train is blown regardless; Tommy assembles the family at his mansion to hand out their shares.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the frame in which the arrests land.

beats.label: S3 · The trap
beats.text: Tommy announces the police are at the door — he has quietly arranged for Polly, Michael, Arthur and John to be arrested for the killings.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's final image and the exact question S4 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: Polly, Michael, Arthur and John sit in police custody, staring down murder charges Tommy engineered without telling them why. Charles is safe. Grace is buried. Whatever the deal is, only Tommy knows it.
questions: What bargain has Tommy struck that required his own family to be arrested?
Will any of them hang before he pulls them out?
Can the Shelby family ever forgive him for the trap?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: Widower and single father to Charles; walked his closest family into a police trap for reasons he has told nobody.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Married to the devout Linda, expecting a child, arrested with the others after promising he would leave the gang.

characters.name: Polly Gray
characters.line: Engaged to the painter Ruben Oliver and midway through building a life, arrested by Tommy's design.

characters.name: Michael Gray
characters.line: Has now killed a man — Father Hughes — and stepped fully inside the family's violence.

characters.name: John Shelby
characters.line: Peaky Blinder middle brother, still married to Esme, one of the four handed to the police.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: About to run the new Boston office, spared the arrests and now the family's American face.

characters.name: Linda Shelby
characters.line: Arthur's Quaker wife, pregnant, and pushing him to walk away from the Peaky Blinders.

characters.name: Grace Shelby
characters.line: Tommy's wife, shot dead at the charity gala by a Changretta shooter avenging Vicente's son Angel.

characters.name: Alfie Solomons
characters.line: Camden ally who quietly sold information to Father Hughes and hasn't yet been called to account for it.

beats.label: S4 · The reprieve
beats.text: Tommy's reprieve arrives at the gallows; the family is spared but scatters, each of them nursing the betrayal alone through the year that follows.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the S3 cliffhanger and sets the estrangement Luca exploits.

beats.label: S4 · Vendetta
beats.text: Letters from Luca Changretta reach every Shelby — a New York mafia vendetta for Vicente. A Christmas ambush leaves John dead and Michael badly wounded.
beats.whyLoadBearing: John's death is the season's inciting loss and reshapes the family for good.

beats.label: S4 · Gold and son
beats.text: The Peaky Blinders regroup; Tommy hires the gypsy killer Aberama Gold and his boxer son Bonnie against Polly's furious objections.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Golds, who reshape Polly's love life and drive S5's Scottish war.

beats.label: S4 · Polly's pact
beats.text: Polly secretly meets Luca and offers to hand Tommy over in exchange for the rest of the family's lives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's cruelest twist — Polly is willing to trade Tommy.

beats.label: S4 · Jessie Eden
beats.text: Jessie Eden pulls Tommy's factory workers out on strike, becoming both a political headache and a romantic entanglement he means to exploit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the communist contacts Tommy will trade to the Crown in the finale.

beats.label: S4 · The basement
beats.text: Arthur fakes his death in a boxing ambush to lure Luca into Tommy's basement distillery, where the Peaky Blinders shoot him down and end the vendetta.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the vendetta and puts Arthur through a rebirth beat.

beats.label: S4 · Parliament
beats.text: Tommy sells Jessie's communist contacts to the Crown in exchange for an endorsement, and wins the Birmingham South seat as a Labour MP.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Tommy in Parliament is the entire premise of S5.

cliffhanger.text: Tommy has just been elected to Parliament, but he bought the seat with his lover's political contacts and hollowed out the family that survived the vendetta. Alfie lies on a beach, presumed dead; John is buried; Michael is boarding a ship for America.
questions: What does Tommy actually want with Parliament?
Can the Shelby Company survive with Michael running the Americas alone?
Now that the family knows he trades in people, who will still work for him?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: Labour MP for Birmingham South and chairman of Shelby Company Ltd; has just betrayed the labour movement he pretended to lead.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Alive; faked his own death to end the vendetta and is nominally born-again under Linda's watch.

characters.name: Polly Gray
characters.line: Shaken by having tried to trade Tommy for the others; now emotionally entangled with Aberama Gold.

characters.name: Michael Gray
characters.line: Survived the ambush and is being sent to run the family's American operation.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: Back from Boston and deep inside the family business, effectively Tommy's political operator.

characters.name: John Shelby
characters.line: Killed in the Christmas ambush by Luca's gunmen — the family's first true loss.

characters.name: Lizzie Stark
characters.line: Tommy's secretary and lover, pregnant with his child at season's end.

characters.name: Aberama Gold
characters.line: Gypsy killer for hire, now allied to the Peaky Blinders and courting Polly; wants his son Bonnie made a full Blinder.

characters.name: Jessie Eden
characters.line: Communist union leader Tommy seduced and then betrayed to the Crown for his political leg up.

beats.label: S5 · Black Tuesday
beats.text: The 1929 crash wipes out the family fortune Michael has been running in New York; he sails back to Birmingham with a new American wife, Gina.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the money crisis and drops Gina into the family — she rewires Michael's loyalty.

beats.label: S5 · The docks
beats.text: Polly suspects Michael tipped off IRA gunmen at the docks; he is cleared, but the doubt lingers and Gina begins whispering in his ear.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First fracture between Tommy and Michael, and the seed of Michael's later plot to unseat him.

beats.label: S5 · Mosley
beats.text: As an MP Tommy meets fascist leader Oswald Mosley, who blackmails him into joining the British Union of Fascists — Tommy resolves to infiltrate and destroy it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and Tommy's secret mission.

beats.label: S5 · Bonnie's death
beats.text: The Scottish Billy Boys shoot Aberama and kill his son Bonnie in a forest; Aberama vows blood, and Tommy folds him into the plan against Mosley.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives Aberama a reason to be at the rally and puts Tommy in bed with Scottish fascists.

beats.label: S5 · Ben Younger
beats.text: Ada, secretly pregnant by Colonel Ben Younger, watches him die in a car bomb meant to destroy Tommy's evidence against Mosley.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Signals the Crown will not protect Tommy and leaves Ada carrying Ben's child.

beats.label: S5 · The sniper
beats.text: Tommy springs his old wartime comrade Barney Thomason from an asylum to be his sniper at Mosley's rally; Michael and Gina meanwhile begin plotting to take over the company.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets both the assassination attempt and the internal coup.

beats.label: S5 · The rally
beats.text: At the rally, unknown gunmen kill Barney and Aberama before they can fire; Mosley walks away untouched, and Tommy breaks and puts a pistol to his own head on the moor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exact cliffhanger — someone inside sold him out and Mosley survives.

cliffhanger.text: Tommy's plan to assassinate Mosley failed because someone he trusted gave it away. He stands on a fog-choked field, gun in his mouth, hallucinating Grace, while Mosley walks free, Michael and Gina circle the throne, and Polly has quit the company.
questions: Who inside the Shelby circle betrayed the plot to Mosley?
Will Tommy pull the trigger, or turn on whoever sold him out?
With Polly gone and Michael scheming, who now runs the Shelby Company?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: MP and undercover anti-fascist; addicted, hallucinating Grace, undone by the failed assassination and with a gun in his mouth.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Abandoned by Linda after he blinded her friend; sinking into cocaine and opium and barely a functioning Peaky.

characters.name: Polly Gray
characters.line: Has resigned from the company over the fascist alliance; not present at the rally and not on speaking terms with Tommy.

characters.name: Michael Gray
characters.line: Openly moving with Gina to seize the Shelby Company from Tommy; a prime suspect for the betrayal.

characters.name: Gina Gray
characters.line: Michael's American wife, niece of a Boston gang boss, quietly steering Michael toward a takeover.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: Carrying the dead Ben Younger's child alone; still one of Tommy's most trusted operators.

characters.name: Lizzie Shelby
characters.line: Married to Tommy and mother of Ruby, watching him disintegrate and trying to pull him out of it.

characters.name: Oswald Mosley
characters.line: Fascist MP with the Crown's protection, target of the failed hit, who now knows someone tried.

beats.label: S6 · The bodies return
beats.text: The IRA's Captain Swing returns Polly, Aberama and Barney's bodies — she saved Mosley for her own reasons. At Polly's grave, Michael vows to kill Tommy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers the S5 cliffhanger and names the two personal enemies who drive the season.

beats.label: S6 · Ruby's death
beats.text: Four years later, Tommy is a sober MP; his daughter Ruby falls ill with tuberculosis and dies despite every treatment the family can buy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The private grief that reshapes every choice Tommy makes for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S6 · The curse
beats.text: Convinced Ruby was cursed through Grace's sapphire, Tommy hunts down the gypsy woman responsible and murders her surviving relatives in revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Tommy's grief pivoting outward into violence — the tone of everything he does after.

beats.label: S6 · Jack Nelson
beats.text: Tommy strikes a deal with Boston gang boss Jack Nelson — Gina's uncle — trading British fascist intelligence for the right to sell opium in America.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Tommy back into business with Mosley's circle and Michael's in-laws in one move.

beats.label: S6 · Duke and Diana
beats.text: Told he has inoperable tuberculoma and a year left, Tommy brings his hidden son Duke into the family; Lizzie leaves him after his affair with Diana Mitford.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Duke and dissolves Tommy's marriage — his personal life reduced to the son he hid.

beats.label: S6 · Garrison Lane
beats.text: Captain Swing's IRA gunmen come to the Garrison to kill Arthur and are shot down in Garrison Lane by the Peaky Blinders — Polly's murder, at last, avenged.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Polly-revenge arc and clears the deck for Tommy's confrontation with Michael.

beats.label: S6 · Miquelon
beats.text: Tommy lures Michael to Miquelon and shoots him dead; then, learning from Ruby's ghost that his diagnosis was a lie, he burns his caravan and rides away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's final image — Michael's death, the fake diagnosis, and Tommy alive and gone.

cliffhanger.text: Tommy has killed Michael, discovered his own death sentence was a fraud engineered by Mosley and Diana, and vanished on horseback. Mosley and the Nazis are ascendant, Arthur is hollowed out but alive, and the Shelby name is scattered between London, Boston and a burnt caravan on a hill.
questions: Where has Tommy gone, and does he mean to come back?
Can he still bring Mosley down now Mosley knows he tried?
Who leads the Shelbys with Tommy vanished and Michael in the ground?

characters.name: Thomas Shelby
characters.line: Widowed father, killer of Michael, riding away alone after learning his terminal diagnosis was a lie planted by Mosley's circle.

characters.name: Arthur Shelby
characters.line: Fought his opium addiction back down enough to gun down the IRA at the Garrison; still a wreck, but alive.

characters.name: Ada Shelby
characters.line: Effectively running the Shelby political operation in Tommy's absence, mother to Ben Younger's child.

characters.name: Lizzie Shelby
characters.line: Has left Tommy over the Diana Mitford affair and taken Charles with her.

characters.name: Michael Gray
characters.line: Dead, shot by Tommy on Miquelon Island in fulfilment of Polly's dying prediction.

characters.name: Duke Shelby
characters.line: Tommy's newly acknowledged illegitimate son, brought into the family late in the season.

characters.name: Diana Mitford
characters.line: Mosley's mistress and now wife; Tommy's lover and one of the pair who faked his diagnosis.

characters.name: Oswald Mosley
characters.line: Fascist leader now allied with the Nazis and openly Tommy's enemy after the false-diagnosis plot.

characters.name: Captain Swing
characters.line: IRA commander who saved Mosley to preserve his usefulness and paid for it with her assassins at the Garrison.
